audience_job.audience: 投委会、投资经理、风控与产品负责人
audience_job.scenario: 季度策略会、组合复盘、风险预算评审、产品路演
audience_job.desired_after_state: 受众理解核心判断、证据链、风险约束和下一步行动

rules.description: Deck lacks audience, scenario, or desired after-state.
Slide lacks a primary narrative job.
Key slide title is only a topic label, not a claim or action.
A claim title has no evidence object, body interpretation, or source/risk note.
Deck arc lacks opening, evidence, risk/turn, or action/closure.
Final slide does not leave action, decision, or monitoring path.
